description: Post-D2 forward arc for Ajay Sanyal — IB Director composite of Ajit Doval. Strategic-handler role, not field operative; decisions are doctrinal and resourcing rather than tactical.
notes: Sanyal's macro-actions are doctrinal posture decisions — what RAW/IB doctrine to commit to and which fronts to escalate. Mortality is essentially zero; the real risk dimensions are reputational/political (mapped to attribution_risk) and institutional (network_durability).

actions.label: Push Naya Bharat into kinetic doctrine
actions.description: Codify offensive cross-border doctrine; expand IB external mandate further. High strategic impact, raises attribution risk.

actions.label: Invest in long-term Pakistan HUMINT rebuild
actions.description: Multi-year capability investment — reseed RAW/IB Pakistan networks post-Hamza. Slow yield, huge network durability.

actions.label: Consolidate domestic CT (Punjab + J&K)
actions.description: Shift balance toward internal security tightening. Lower attribution risk, lower strategic ceiling.

actions.label: Pressure diaspora host nations diplomatically
actions.description: Use government channels to push Canada/UK/US on Khalistan-funding actors. Lower attribution risk than kinetic ops, slower payoff.

actions.label: Authorise post-Pahalgam kinetic strikes
actions.description: Sign off on Sindoor-style cross-border operation. Maximum strategic impact, maximum attribution risk.

actions.label: Plan graceful institutional succession
actions.description: Begin handover to deputy (Sushant Bansal). Locks in network durability; ends Sanyal's active arc.

events.label: Post-D2 doctrinal review
events.description: Punjab op concluded; doctrinal review underway. Sanyal sets next phase posture.

events.label: ISI counter-intel pressure peaks
events.description: Hamza/Rizwan exposure rising; Sanyal must decide whether to invest in HUMINT rebuild or consolidate domestically.

events.label: Diaspora radicalisation surge
events.description: Canada/UK diaspora becomes a primary issue; choose between diplomatic pressure and continued kinetic doctrine push.

events.label: Pahalgam attack
events.description: TRF attack on civilians forces immediate doctrinal posture decision.

events.label: Operation Sindoor planning
events.description: Final doctrinal commitment before kinetic phase begins.
